images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Redraw a polished production character proportion sheet for Pelican 429, a 2.5D side scrolling action game. Image 1 is the EXISTING HERO style and scale reference: preserve the brown-haired child in red sweater, jeans, white sneakers, wrist technology. Match his rounded premium animated-film stylization, large readable shapes, clean materials and restrained cyan/orange status lights. Image 2 is the old enemy identity reference ONLY: correct its proportions as directed. Modern robotics with believable joints, white polymer shells, graphite mechanics, selective accent color. No thin elongated adult superhero anatomy, no oversized spindly limbs, no photoreal dirt, no dense greebles, no weapons or explosive components. Layout: one large orthographic FRONT view on left and one equally scaled true orthographic SIDE view facing RIGHT on right, both grounded on the same thin baseline, identical character dimensions and design across views. At far left include a smaller-space but SAME SCALE full-body existing hero comparison, not a tiny unrelated inset. Neutral light gray studio backdrop, soft shadows, no perspective distortion, plenty of margin. Labels only HERO / FRONT / SIDE. Landscape 3:2 high detail concept illustration. Enemy: humanoid clamp maintenance/security robot. Height 1.10 times hero. Four-head-tall body, slightly enlarged smooth compact helmet with black single amber circular optic, NO tall crest; shorter neck; compact broad torso; sturdy rounded upper arms, one modest tool clamp forearm and one five-finger robotic hand. Both hands reach upper thigh, never knees. Legs comprise about 44% of total height, proportionate wide stable feet. White shell with desaturated navy shoulder caps and small teal sternum. Readable friendly-industrial silhouette yet credible enemy. Clearly bigger than hero only slightly.
edits: Edit this character sheet. Preserve hero exactly. REDESIGN THE ROBOT BODY proportions substantially in BOTH FRONT and SIDE. Increase helmet diameter 35 percent, shorten legs 25 percent, shorten torso 15 percent, shorten both arms so clamp bottom reaches upper thigh clearly ABOVE knee. Robot total height only 1.08 times hero height (hero hair top y185 and baseline y905 in reference means robot top should be y128 not y45). Keep same visor amber ring, white navy teal colors and mechanical joints. No superhero waist and no long neck. Same baseline, same new dimensions in both views. Make it belong to hero's rounded animated game world. Labels HERO FRONT SIDE only.
